objective: Accelerate end-to-end validation without contaminating the massive-hit evidence model.

lane_A_engineering_fullsong.purpose: Validate complete-song TMT extraction, Matrix X plumbing, readiness, generation and TTFP using openly available full-song symbolic corpora.
allowed_sources: other open full-song symbolic corpora with explicit provenance

lane_B_target_massive_hits.purpose: Build the actual prototype evidence model from full-song representations of massive hits within the rolling 20-year window.
allowed_sources: Lakh MIDI full/clean/matched when title-artist match is auditable
other full-song symbolic sources meeting provenance and coverage gates

hard_rules: Lane A results cannot be merged into Lane B cohort statistics.
Only FULL_SONG coverage can enter Matrix X used for generation readiness.
A symbolic transcription must be identity-audited before promotion to target evidence.
Open-source engineering success is not evidence that the massive-hit model works.
rationale: Run full-song E2E immediately on open symbolic data while independently resolving full-song symbolic matches for massive hits. This reduces wall-clock time without weakening the population definition.
